newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh taka eases at close on dlr demand.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh taka eases at close on dlr demand.

text.p: The Bangladesh taka closed weaker at 42.8460/8490 to the dollar in an active interbank session on Tuesday against a previous close at 42.8450/8465, dealers said.
The local unit was quoted mostly steady at 42.8440/8470 per dollar in early trade but lost ground later amid substantial purchases of the greenback by importers, dealers said.
The call money rates closed flat at 8.0 to 8.5 percent.
